commands.cmd: p=$(command -v ccusage) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && ccusage --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" ccusage

t=$(date -u +%Y%m%d); y2=$(date -u -v-2d +%Y%m%d 2>/dev/null || date -u -d '2 days ago' +%Y%m%d); out=$(ccusage claude daily --json --offline --no-cost --timezone UTC --since "$y2" --until "$t"); ccrc=$?; printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
ccrc = int(sys.argv[1])
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
rows = d.get('daily', [])
totals = d.get('totals', {})
row_fields = sorted(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []
totals_fields = sorted(totals.keys())
keys = ('inputTokens', 'outputTokens', 'cacheCreationTokens', 'cacheReadTokens')
per_day_ok = all(sum(r.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == r.get('totalTokens') for r in rows)
grand_ok = sum(totals.get(k, 0) for k in keys) == totals.get('totalTokens')
has_cost = 'totalCost' in totals or any('totalCost' in r for r in rows)
ok = ccrc == 0 and len(rows) >= 1 and per_day_ok and grand_ok and not has_cost
print('ccusage exit code:', ccrc, '| rows:', len(rows), '| row field names:', row_fields, '| totals field names:', totals_fields, '| per-day totals equal sum of their own category fields:', per_day_ok, '| grand total equal to sum of its category fields:', grand_ok, '| totalCost field present:', has_cost)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
" "$ccrc"
